_comment: Parameters for the dev stack (stock-news-dashboard-dev). scripts/deploy.py adds Environment, ReleaseId and OpsBucketName; the ALARM_EMAIL and SEC_USER_AGENT environment variables (GitHub variables in CI) override AlarmEmail and SecUserAgent.
_modelProfileComment: Models come from infra/models.json. 'sonnet-4-6' (Claude Sonnet 4.6 writer, Claude Haiku 4.5 judge) is the interim profile while Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 are not available for this account; switch to 'target' once check-models --model-profile target passes.
